misprints.note: Headword printed without the diaeresis on O; all neighbouring headwords have Ö.
Alpha carries both breathing and an acute, and omicron also has an acute: there is one accent too many.
Clearly π in the print. The attested word is ἀταλόφρων.
Full stop where the rest of the series has a comma before the termination number.
There is a blank gap between ουσα and ον, so the comma or dash appears to have dropped out of the forme.

uncertain.note: Gap with no visible mark between ουσα and ον. I transcribed it as a plain space.
I see no iota subscript under η in the print, so I wrote χρήζειν, not χρῄζειν.
The small marks look like rough breathing with acute. Grave cannot be fully excluded.
The left edge of the first line is clipped. I read it as the genitive ending of ἀλγηδών, which is continued from the column above.
